  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The "Look up before creating" bullet checks a `pr-<N>.md` log's `- Reference:` line only when the requested PR is external, so a run for this repository's (THIS_REPO's) own PR #N resumes any existing `pr-<N>.md` without that check, even when the log names an external PR.
  WHY: Under the old rule, external PR logs were written as `pr-<N>.md`, and the new rule leaves them where they are ("Never rename or move an existing log"), so the command can resume another project's runbook, skip its `[x]` steps, write this repository's step evidence into the wrong file, or report `Status: LIVE` for a PR that was never activated; all reviewers rated this MAJOR (mapped to high), and confidence ranged from 3 to 5.
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/deploy-activate.md:57-63 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The template copy of the "Look up before creating" bullet has the same gap: `pr-<N>.md` is checked against its `- Reference:` line only when the requested PR is external, so a legacy external-PR log can be resumed for this repository's PR with the same number.
  WHY: This is the same clash with legacy logs as in the root copy, and it causes the wrong project to be resumed or reported LIVE; all reviewers rated this MAJOR (mapped to high), and confidence ranged from 3 to 5.

- .claude/commands/deploy-activate.md:53 and workflow-templates/.claude/commands/deploy-activate.md:60 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The "Look up before creating" bullet resumes `pr-<N>.md` for an external PR, and `pr-<repo>-<N>.md`, only when the `- Reference:` line names that PR; there is no matching condition for a PR in this repository (`THIS_REPO`), so a legacy external `pr-<N>.md` is resumed through the "If a log exists, it is the source of truth" path in Step 1 and the "Read first (mandatory)" bullet without its Reference being read.
  WHY: The command resumes the other project's runbook, skips that log's `[x]` steps, and can report `Status: LIVE` for a PR that was never activated; this is the clash the issue describes ("the name could also clash with that repo's own PR #37"), which was possible before this PR and is still uncovered in this direction.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTION (same location, both copies): add the sentence "For a PR in this repo, resume `pr-<N>.md` only when its `- Reference:` line does not name a PR in another repository; otherwise stop and ask which log to use." Estimate: 1 line per copy, plus 1 assertion in tests/test_deploy_activate_command.py. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
- Task completeness: NONE. The reviewer noted that `docs/deploy-activation/README.md` lines 10-11 still document only `pr-<N>.md`, but did not count this as a gap because the file is outside `files_touched` and the issue does not ask for it.
